siteTitle: Aravinth R | Senior Technical Support Engineer
name: Aravinth R
heroSummary: A Senior Technical Support Engineer and Product Support Analyst with 6+ years of experience keeping enterprise SaaS and healthcare technology running smoothly for global customers. I turn complex production issues into clear root causes, lasting fixes, and documentation that cuts repeat tickets.

paragraphs: I’m a Senior Technical Support Engineer based in Chennai with 6+ years of experience in L2/L3 application and production support for enterprise SaaS and healthcare technology platforms.

I work at the point where customers, product, and engineering meet. I investigate issues using SQL, REST API testing, and log analysis, find the root cause, and work with Product, Development, QA, and DevOps to ship fixes that last. I’m just as focused on the people side: clear communication, calm escalation handling, and mentoring teammates.

Along the way I’ve written 30+ knowledge articles that reduced inbound tickets by 12%, supported releases and UAT, and kept SLA compliance at 98% for global clients. I believe great support isn’t just closing tickets. It’s making sure the same problem never happens twice.

experiences.title: Senior Engineer, Tech Support
experiences.description:
Resolve complex application, configuration, and data incidents for global clients on enterprise SaaS and healthcare platforms
Lead escalations with Product, Dev, QA, and DevOps to deliver workarounds and long-term fixes for client-impacting issues
Validate systems and investigate data, keeping clients informed through the full support lifecycle
Write troubleshooting guides, mentor teammates, and spot recurring issues to improve reliability

experiences.title: Issue Resolution Analyst (Application Support)
experiences.company: Athenahealth Technology Pvt Ltd, Chennai, India
experiences.description: Delivered L2/L3 application and production support, including on-call coverage, while managing high-volume JIRA and ServiceNow queues under ITSM processes and SLA targets. Diagnosed application, database, data and API issues using SQL queries, data validation, REST API testing with Insomnia and log analysis. Performed incident, problem and change management; completed root cause analysis and documented corrective actions to reduce repeat incidents. Supported release activities and UAT, and authored 30+ Confluence knowledge articles that reduced inbound tickets by 12%.
